title: Annotatio III §.V close: Both sides repeatedly acknowledge each other’s Confessions and churches as true and Orthodox — Bohemica/Helvetica and Augustana Socii (Misc. Sacr. I p. 703); stop before §.VI
pass_a_gloss: From either side they not once only mutually acknowledge Confessions and Churches as true: We have agreed, that just as those (Associates of the Augsburg Confession) testify that we, and our Churches and our Confession published in this Synod and of the Brethren, are Orthodox [so speak the Associates of the Bohemian Confession of themselves and of the associates of the Helvetic Confession], so also we may pursue their Churches [namely of the Associates of the Augsburg Confession] with the same Christian love and confess them Orthodox — Miscellaneous Sacred Things, Part 1, p. 703.
pass_b_english: From both sides they more than once acknowledge each other’s Confessions and churches as true.

We have agreed: just as the Augsburg Confession’s associates testify that we, our churches, and our Confession published in this synod of the Brethren are Orthodox — so the Bohemian Confession’s associates speak of themselves and of the Helvetic Confession’s associates — so also we will pursue their churches (the Augsburg associates’) with the same Christian love and confess them Orthodox (Hornbeck, Miscel. Sacr. Part 1, p. 703).
source_text: Ab utraque parte haud semel Confessiones & Ecclesias mutuo agnoscunt pro veris: Convenimus, ut quemadmodum illi (August. Conf. Socii) nos, nostrasque Ecclesias & Confessionem nostram in hac Synodo publicatam & Fratrum, Orthodoxas testantur [ita Bohemicae Confessionis Socii de se & Helveticae Confessionis sociis loquuntur] sic etiam nos illorum Ecclesias [puta Augustanae Confessionis Sociorum] eodem Christiano amore prosequamur & Orthodoxas fateamur, Miscel. Sacr. Part. 1. p. 703.

lemmas.latin: Confessiones & Ecclesias mutuo agnoscunt pro veris
lemmas.gloss: mutually acknowledge Confessions and Churches as true
